title: RPG Maker VX Ace , create lag on purpose?

posts.author: Xenoriginal
posts.body:
Hello, a bit of a weird question, but I've found threads on here discussing how to reduce lag in VX Ace games, and thought I could get some suggestions here.
I'm making a quick game for my friends using VX Ace, and I want to purposely make the game lag as badly as possible. From what I've read, I've tried a few methods, like making the maps as large as possible and adding lots of unnecessary events that run as parallel processes with conditional branches, but these seem to have no effect on the game's framerate.
I've made larger scale games before and know I have experienced lag before, but have no idea how to recreate it on purpose. I wanted to ask if anyone had any suggestions/experiences with lag, and a method to purposely add lag to a game.
Thank you.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Found this thread here:

posts.author: Xenoriginal
posts.body: This is exactly what I was hoping for! Thank you so much for the help, this solution is so much simpler than what I was trying.
